unit.why: A short anecdote: the subject meets the Apter Rav in Mezhibozh, who gives him a blessing in the form of a homily, and the text reports that the blessing came true.
unit.boundary_note: Second numbered item in a series about the same rabbi (continues the biography begun in the previous division); next division is a separate anecdote.

stories.summary_en: When the author's master came to R. Abraham Joshua Heschel of Apta in Mezhibozh, the Apter expounded 'ונתנך ה׳ לראש ולא לזנב' as a promise that he would be a head among heads, and the blessing was fulfilled.

quotes: כתיב ונתנך ה׳ לראש ולא לזנב ולכאורה הוא כפל לשון
tags.why: The core is the tzaddik's exegesis of a verse.
A minimal narrative frame around a homiletic interpretation.
The blessing works as a prediction of leadership that came true.
The arc runs from blessing or prediction to its fulfilment.

quotes: כאשר זכה לקבל פני הרה״ק רשכב"ה
tags.why: He came to be received by the Apter Rav.
The tzaddik receives the visitor and greets him with a blessing.
The tzaddik's blessing has effective power.
